description: Owned original Call of Duty 4 content

sources.instructions: Obtain the original 2007 Call of Duty 4, not the remaster. Copy fileSysCheck.cfg, all main/*.iwd and the full compatible zone/ fastfiles. Do not replace existing server.cfg. Managed import selects only the declared IWD/config and recognized fastfile paths. Any additional zone content requires manual staging; file checks do not prove completeness.
